gate_namespace: pangu G00-G11; Rust historical Gxx identifiers are unrelated

verdict_rules.PASS: Both executions and required comparisons succeeded with current complete evidence; documented intentional differences must match approved rule and limit compatibility claim.
verdict_rules.FAIL: Deterministic observed behavior or required invariant disagrees.
verdict_rules.BLOCKED: Missing runtime/case/credential/environment/artifact; timeout; malformed evidence; test not implemented. Never count as pass.
verdict_rules.NOT_APPLICABLE: Protected approved profile excludes the item; author cannot select it unilaterally.

required_case_set_rule: approved required case IDs minus valid protected exclusions; no percentage-based escape
normalization_forbidden: ignore unregistered event or field differences
validation_requirements: reject evidence referring to stale candidate or policy
verify every artifact hash and source scope
include BLOCKED and missing in required-set denominator
do not infer proof from file existence or historical PASS summary
real endpoint text quality is separate from deterministic parity
release_requirements: all required checks completed without FAIL/BLOCKED
approved measured budgets, no required UNBASELINED metric
final package provenance and dependency checks
never_store: raw user secrets or unapproved production content
